decision_policy.resource_regression: no registers, local/stack, shared-memory or occupancy regression

decisions.rationale: Validated uint32 indexing keeps identical mappings and materially reduces kernel time.
The 512-thread launches maximize measured throughput despite lower resident-block count.
The large non-central-chi-square helper remains noinline when timing and resources reject forced inlining.
FP64 accumulation is retained because both faster mixed variants introduce measurable stress-stream error.
The bounded direct convolution remains experimental; the production FFT path wins the measured eight-step workload.
The 65536-path reusable workspace chunk gives the best measured single-price throughput within the declared VRAM budget.
